build: g++ -O2 -fPIC; source list from upstream CMakeLists.txt ly_common_source_files; no LIBYUV_UNLIMITED defines; scalar CPU mask1 and automatic SIMD both exact
format: repeated little-endian six u32: width,height,format400/420/422/444,matrix,full,alpha; tightly packed Y/U/V/A existing planes; width*height*4 expected straight RGBA
alpha_input: alpha.avif from existing MANIFEST.json; YUV plane bytes decoded using pinned Crabby+rav1d; RGB solely from pinned reference libyuv
limits: conversion oracle, not independent AV1 decoding oracle; evidence-only build not a production/test dependency
